title: Lush Herbed Ethiopian Almond Butter Stew
description: A rich and fragrant plant-based stew featuring a velvety almond butter base infused with traditional Ethiopian niter kibbeh spices and fresh green herbs.

ingredients.name: canola oil
ingredients.notes: infused with cardamom, fenugreek, and nigella seeds

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.notes: peeled and cut into one-inch cubes

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat and stir in the infused spices until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, and ginger, cooking until the onions are soft and translucent.
Toss in the sweet potato cubes and stir to coat them with the aromatic oil mixture.
Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the liquid to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for fifteen minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender.
Whisk the almond butter with a half cup of the hot broth in a small bowl until smooth, then stir it back into the pot.
Add the chopped collard greens and cook for five minutes until they are wilted and bright green.
Stir in the fresh chopped herbs right before serving to maintain their vibrant color and flavor.
